items.summary: Chandigarh is preparing to add a new attraction to its popular Rose Festival, with helicopter rides being planned to offer visitors an aerial view of the city. The Municipal Corporation is reported to be considering an expenditure of 1.32 crore for the proposed initiative. The plan could give tourists and residents an opportunity to experience Chandigarh from the sky while enjoying one of the citys best-known annual events. The Rose Festival attracts visitors with its colourful flower displays
